2026-10-27.text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

2026-10-28.text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

2026-10-29.text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

2026-10-30.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

2026-10-31.text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

2026-11-01.text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

2026-11-02.text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
